_doc: Otter v1.0 — operator-tunable config. Wallet/chatId/decision_model resolved from env vars at runtime install (${WALLET_ADDRESS}, ${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}, ${OTTER_DECISION_MODEL}); do NOT hardcode here. Risk gates, leverage caps, and asset cooldowns are enforced by the runtime via runtime.yaml and the producer's hardcoded constants.

tiers._note: max conviction — extreme OI velocity + 4h confirms + price strong + SM aligned

marginPct._note: 25% of account value per slot. Override per-deploy via OTTER_MARGIN_PCT env var.

entry._note: These mirror otter-producer.py's hardcoded constants. Producer constants WIN — config is informational/audit only in v2.

history._note: 5 min cron cadence × 60 samples = 5h rolling window. First 12 ticks (1h) build baseline before any signals can fire.

_runtime_owns._doc: These were v1 concerns. In v2, the runtime owns them via runtime.yaml.guard_rails. DO NOT add gates here.
_runtime_owns.execution.entryOrderType: runtime.actions.otter_entry.params.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT, ensure_execution_as_taker:false — entries cancel-and-skip if maker can't fill)
_runtime_owns.execution.exitOrderType: runtime.exit.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT, ensure_execution_as_taker:true — exits use taker fallback as safety floor)
